The dominant material is glazed ceramic. A standard ceramic bowl of this size weighs approximately 0.4 to 0.6 kg. The density of ceramic is roughly 2000-2500 kg/m³. For rigid body simulation in Isaac Sim v4.5, a convex decomposition or SDF mesh is required to accurately represent the concavity of the bowl, allowing objects to be placed inside it. Glazed ceramic has a relatively low friction coefficient (similar to glass, around 0.2-0.4) and moderate to high restitution (0.5-0.7) depending on the object it collides with. CCD is recommended if it will be dropped or interact with fast-moving small objects. A small rest offset (e.g., 0.0) is ideal for visual accuracy, and a standard contact offset (e.g., 0.005) ensures stable constraint generation.
